name: DSW Capital plc
summary: Operating across the United Kingdom, DSW Capital plc delivers a diverse range of professional services. The firm provides expert corporate finance advisory, meticulous financial due diligence, business recovery support, and equity finance solutions. Its extensive service portfolio also covers DSW venture initiatives, comprehensive wealth management advice, forensic accounting and valuation, strategic business planning, and both debt and tax consultation services. Additionally, the company offers industrial property solutions and specialized funding and guidance for entities in the technology and media sectors. DSW Capital plc was established in 2002 and operates from its headquarters in Warrington, UK.
